Notepad++ Update Infrastructure Compromise

Target: notepad-plus-plus
Repository: https://github.com/notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus
Date: 2025-06-01 to 2025-10-31 (152 days)
Attribution: Nation State
Component: Application
Language: C++
Cause: Compromised Infrastructure
Motive: Espionage
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Remote Access/Backdoor
User Impact: 0
Domain: notepad-plus-plus.org (vendor)
Artifact Type: application
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Attackers compromised the Notepad++ update infrastructure at the hosting provider level, distributing malicious update.exe files. They deployed Cobalt Strike Beacons and Chrysalis backdoors to targeted organizations in specific regions between June and October 2025.
